global_claim: For the exact actual arithmetic target and complete factor-region potential in the program, there exists integer q0>=1 such that every integer q>=q0 admits finite Cq>=0 independent of X, and every dyadic integer X>=1 satisfies E(2X)+V(2X)-E(X)-V(X)<=Cq ceil(X^(1/q)). E is the complete actual filtered-prefix block energy divided by X^2; V is the frozen nonnegative combination of full signed Gram squares with exact normalizers. Regions use the smallest prime factor, its full positive valuation and p-free core. Every cutoff, component and child transition is retained and reevaluated at its own scale. Stored constants are finite fits, not assertions about unknown existential constants.
